title: [Insight] Wrong Extended TBR
body:
I started to analyse log file, Real amount injected in pump was 0.08U and not 2.2U
It's seems that I recieved from pump a wrong "updated amount" (Very rare but probably an old bug I already noticed sometimes very high TBR in the past) (Amount sent 0.38U 30 min, Amount updated after 5 min 2.2U ????)
